style_notes: Eight-sided stockade silhouette with tightly spaced jagged upright logs and narrow observation gaps.
Conical steep irregular thatched roof constructed from layered bundles of reed and fir bark.
Structure rests on rough stone footings secured by stone-age lashing knots and X-braced timber supports.
Natural uneven textures define the form, avoiding modern symmetry or clean board-and-batten cabin styles.
